confidence_notes: Food anchors follow Rovaniemi's published typical price levels. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain; they are bounded from local bar prices relative to draft beer. Accommodation is a holistic year-typical estimate, with substantial seasonal uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Relative to the supplied Helsinki prices, Rovaniemi is estimated to carry a seasonal tourism premium. Year-typical room estimates account for quieter periods as well as stronger winter demand.
